verdict.line: You lose extended trades before level 6 while his Parrrley poke outranges your whole kit, but you win the fight once Remove Scurvy and Raise Morale are both down.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's Grog-Soaked Blade poison plus the 625-range Parrrley let him win short trades from outside your 300-range Q and 325-range W, forcing you to close distance before your kit does anything. The 46% win rate over 189 games and Gangplank's lane-advantage rating both come from this one gap: he decides when the trade starts, you decide when it ends.

theirWindow.when: His W and E are both up
theirWindow.what: If you engage here he can cleanse your Q (Thundering Smash) stun mid-animation with Remove Scurvy and buff his own AD/move speed with Raise Morale first. Don't commit Q into this window - poke with E (Sky Splitter) instead and back off.

yourWindow.what: This is the only window your Q stun actually sticks for its full duration. Walk him down, land Q, then chain W (Frenzied Maul) twice on the same target for the recast's bonus damage and heal before he can cleanse anything.

start.why: 48.5% win rate over 171 games as the top pick (69.5%). The regen and mana sustain let you spam E (Sky Splitter) to answer his poke from range instead of eating free poison stacks in melee.

boots.why: 44.8% win rate, 58.3% pick rate. Gangplank's damage is almost entirely basic-attack-and-poison based, so flat auto-attack mitigation directly counters his main source of lane damage.

core.why: Best-performing core path (46.2% over 13 games). The active heal/slow helps you close his range advantage and sustain through poison stacks.
Attack speed scales your Frenzied Maul recast pattern and Relentless Storm passive, letting your on-hits punish him once you're in range.
Completes the highest-sample core build; the on-hit damage profile keeps rewarding your W-recast trading pattern into extended fights.

situational.when: his poison and Parrrley poke are draining your HP bar before you hit level 6
he's stacking crit or lethality and his autos are swinging the trade too hard
you're ahead on the powercurve by level 9-13 and want to snowball the attack-speed spike

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed rewards exactly the trade pattern this matchup forces on you: stack autos and W recasts once you're inside his range, rather than relying on a single burst window.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 70% of games and sits at 47.1% win rate - the dominant pick. Ignite punishes his all-in windows and offsets the sustain race against his passive poison, which matters since solo-kill odds here are rated even.

playing.title: Track his Remove Scurvy cooldown
playing.detail: It's 22/21/20/19/18s and clears CC - if it's up, your Q (Thundering Smash) stun can be cleansed mid-fight. Only commit your all-in when it's down.

playing.title: Don't walk up into Parrrley range
playing.detail: His Q outranges your entire kit at 625 vs your Q's 300 and W's 325. Use E (Sky Splitter, 1200 range) to contest waves and poke instead of approaching on even terms.

playing.title: Double-tap W for the heal
playing.detail: Recasting Frenzied Maul on the same target deals bonus damage and heals you - use this every trade to win the sustain race against his poison stacks.

playing.title: Stand in your own E blast
playing.detail: Sky Splitter grants you a shield if you're inside the radius when it lands. Use it as your engage tool, not just as poke, when you commit to a fight.

playing.title: Respect Raise Morale timing
playing.detail: It's a 20s cooldown that buffs his AD and move speed. If it's up alongside Remove Scurvy, he can both cleanse and out-damage you - wait for one or both to be down.

playing.title: Power spike at Gunblade/Shiv completion
playing.detail: Levels 9-13 is where your core items flip the sustained trade in your favor. Play passive before this, aggressive after.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner picks above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown numbers and ability behavior are from the live game files. The timing windows and trade sequencing are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of his Grasp of the Undying + (Q) combo. Use [E] to contest lane while waiting for when his (E) is on cooldown to close in and fight him.
